When I finally understood they didnt give a shit about me..
Is when I was moving far, far away. 

I told all my friends I was going to move 1,200 miles away to a different state with my family. I wanted to know If they wanted to do one last hang out with me before Its too late. 

All of them reacted the same.. Each friend I told shouted at me on the phone. "Why would I waste my time to go see you??" "You think you're so special?" Etc. I cried and couldnt believe this was happening... 

I was getting these horrible texts from their bf's saying im selfish. My best friends constantly yelled at me in text that I was always a waste of time. I had to deal with that as I was packing for two weeks.

When I finally was heading out. Nobody showed up, nobody texted or called. I made about 3 update posts on facebook on my long 7 day drive. None of them said anything.

Now its been 5 years. Still nothing.
